scientific_integrity: Theorem is given with definitions, quantified domain, analytic proof and a reproducing numerical checker. Prior mean-optimal result is credited; no independent scientific validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Brownian one-dimensional motion; instantaneous homogeneous Poisson resets; an exponential target distance sampled once and retained across all resets.
General moment criterion is restricted to positive integer orders; does not address fractional moments, exact survival-law tails, or non-Poisson protocol optimization.
Potential derivability from broader renewal-mixture limit theorems remains a publication-priority risk.
title: Infinite variance at mean-optimal Poisson resetting for an exponentially distributed fixed target
